/-!
# Leopoldt's conjecture

Leopoldt's conjecture states that the $p$-adic regulator of a number field $K$ does not vanish.
The $p$-adic regulator is an analogue of the usual regulator, defined using $p$-adic logarithms
instead of the usual logarithms.

Precise formulation (following the Wikipedia article). Let $K$ be a number field and $p$ a
rational prime. For each prime $P$ of $K$ above $p$, let $U_{1,P}$ be the group of principal
units of the completion $K_P$, i.e. the local units $u$ with $u \equiv 1 \pmod P$, and set
$U_1 = \prod_{P \mid p} U_{1,P}$. Let $E_1$ be the group of global units $\varepsilon$ of $K$
whose image under the diagonal embedding $\varepsilon \mapsto (\varepsilon)_{P \mid p}$ lies in
$U_1$. Since $E_1$ has finite index in the unit group of $K$, it is an abelian group of rank
$r_1 + r_2 - 1$, where $r_1$ is the number of real embeddings of $K$ and $r_2$ the number of
pairs of complex embeddings. Leopoldt's conjecture states that the $\mathbb{Z}_p$-module rank of
the closure $\overline{E_1}$ of $E_1$ embedded diagonally in $U_1$ is also $r_1 + r_2 - 1$;
equivalently, the *Leopoldt defect*
$\delta_p(K) = (r_1 + r_2 - 1) - \operatorname{rank}_{\mathbb{Z}_p} \overline{E_1}$ is zero.

The conjecture is known when $K$ is an abelian extension of $\mathbb{Q}$ or of an imaginary
quadratic field (Ax, Brumer).

*References:*
- [Wikipedia, Leopoldt's conjecture](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leopoldt%27s_conjecture)
- [Wikipedia, List of unsolved problems in mathematics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_unsolved_problems_in_mathematics)
- H.-W. Leopoldt, *Zur Arithmetik in abelschen Zahlkörpern*, J. Reine Angew. Math. 209 (1962),
  54–71.
- J. Neukirch, A. Schmidt, K. Wingberg, *Cohomology of Number Fields*, 2nd ed., Springer, 2008,
  Chapter X, §3.
- L. C. Washington, *Introduction to Cyclotomic Fields*, 2nd ed., Springer, 1997, Chapter 5.
-/

blocks.code:
def HasZpRank (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type*) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] (r : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ H : Subgroup G, IsOpen (H : Set G) ∧ Nonempty (H ≃ₜ* (Fin r → Multiplicative ℤ_[p]))
blocks.docstring:
A topological group $G$ *has $\mathbb{Z}_p$-rank $r$* if it has an open subgroup which is
topologically isomorphic to $\mathbb{Z}_p^r$ (with $\mathbb{Z}_p$ written multiplicatively).

For a finitely generated $\mathbb{Z}_p$-module $M$ carrying its $p$-adic topology (for instance
any closed subgroup of the group $U_1$ of principal local units), this holds exactly when the
$\mathbb{Z}_p$-module rank of $M$ is $r$: if $M \cong \mathbb{Z}_p^r \times T$ with $T$ finite,
then $\mathbb{Z}_p^r \times \{0\}$ is an open subgroup topologically isomorphic to
$\mathbb{Z}_p^r$; conversely, a topological group isomorphism from $\mathbb{Z}_p^r$ onto an open
subgroup $H$ of $M$ is automatically $\mathbb{Z}_p$-linear, and $H$ has finite index in the
compact group $M$, so $M$ has rank $r$.

justification.closest_existing_considered: `Module.finrank ℤ_[p]` / `Module.rank` (require a `Module ℤ_[p]` instance on U_1, which does not exist); `AdicCompletion` for ℤ-modules (gives ℤ_p ⊗ E_1 but no map to U_1); p-adic logarithms on K_P (not in Mathlib).
justification.name: LeopoldtsConjecture.HasZpRank
justification.why_needed: Mathlib has no ℤ_p-module structure (hence no `Module.finrank ℤ_[p]`) on the principal units of an adic completion of a number field, so the ℤ_p-rank of a closed subgroup of U_1 cannot be stated directly. `HasZpRank p G r` (G has an open subgroup topologically isomorphic to ℤ_p^r) captures 'rank_{ℤ_p} G = r' for finitely generated ℤ_p-modules with their p-adic topology using only topological-group primitives.

blocks.name: HasZpRank
blocks.text:
/-- A topological group $G$ *has $\mathbb{Z}_p$-rank $r$* if it has an open subgroup which is
topologically isomorphic to $\mathbb{Z}_p^r$ (with $\mathbb{Z}_p$ written multiplicatively).

For a finitely generated $\mathbb{Z}_p$-module $M$ carrying its $p$-adic topology (for instance

subgroup $H$ of $M$ is automatically $\mathbb{Z}_p$-linear, and $H$ has finite index in the
compact group $M$, so $M$ has rank $r$. -/
def HasZpRank (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type*) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] (r : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ H : Subgroup G, IsOpen (H : Set G) ∧ Nonempty (H ≃ₜ* (Fin r → Multiplicative ℤ_[p]))

@[category test, AMS 11]
theorem hasZpRank_pi (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (r : ℕ) :
    HasZpRank p (Fin r → Multiplicative ℤ_[p]) r :=
  ⟨⊤, by simp,
    ⟨{ Subgroup.topEquiv with
        continuous_toFun := continuous_subtype_val
        continuous_invFun := continuous_id.subtype_mk _ }⟩⟩

blocks.code: abbrev PrimesAbove : Type _ := {P : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K) // (p : 𝓞 K) ∈ P.asIdeal}
blocks.docstring:
The primes $P$ of the number field $K$ lying above the rational prime $p$, i.e. the nonzero
prime ideals of the ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_K$ containing $p$.

justification.closest_existing_considered: `Ideal.primesOver` (a `Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))`, not height-one-spectrum elements, so not directly usable with `adicCompletion`; `IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.equivPrimesOver` shows the two agree).
justification.name: LeopoldtsConjecture.PrimesAbove
justification.why_needed: Index type for the primes P | p of K, needed to form ∏_{P|p} K_Pˣ via `HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion`.

blocks.name: PrimesAbove

blocks.code: abbrev AdicUnits : Type _ := (P : PrimesAbove K p) → (P.1.adicCompletion K)ˣ
blocks.docstring:
The product $\prod_{P \mid p} K_P^\times$ of the multiplicative groups of the completions
$K_P$ of $K$ at the primes $P$ above $p$, with the product topology. It contains the group
$\prod_{P \mid p} U_P$ of local units and the group $U_1 = \prod_{P \mid p} U_{1,P}$ of principal
local units, and it is the target of the diagonal embedding of the global units.

justification.closest_existing_considered: No existing bundled product of units of adic completions over primes above p; `NumberField.FinitePlace` / `FinitePlace.completion` exist but are indexed by places rather than height-one primes and offer no advantage here.
justification.name: LeopoldtsConjecture.AdicUnits
justification.why_needed: Abbreviation for the topological group ∏_{P|p} (K_P)ˣ, the target of the diagonal embedding and the ambient group for the closure.

blocks.name: AdicUnits
blocks.text:
/-- The product $\prod_{P \mid p} K_P^\times$ of the multiplicative groups of the completions
$K_P$ of $K$ at the primes $P$ above $p$, with the product topology. It contains the group
$\prod_{P \mid p} U_P$ of local units and the group $U_1 = \prod_{P \mid p} U_{1,P}$ of principal
local units, and it is the target of the diagonal embedding of the global units. -/
abbrev AdicUnits : Type _ := (P : PrimesAbove K p) → (P.1.adicCompletion K)ˣ

blocks.code:
noncomputable def diagonalEmbedding : (𝓞 K)ˣ →* AdicUnits K p :=
  Pi.monoidHom fun P => Units.map (algebraMap (𝓞 K) (P.1.adicCompletion K)).toMonoidHom
blocks.docstring:
The diagonal embedding $\varepsilon \mapsto (\varepsilon)_{P \mid p}$ of the global units
$\mathcal{O}_K^\times$ of $K$ into $\prod_{P \mid p} K_P^\times$.

justification.closest_existing_considered: `Pi.monoidHom` and `Units.map (algebraMap ...)` (used to build it); no ready-made diagonal embedding of global units into completions exists.
justification.name: LeopoldtsConjecture.diagonalEmbedding
justification.why_needed: The diagonal map (𝓞 K)ˣ →* ∏_{P|p} (K_P)ˣ, ε ↦ (ε)_P, used to define E_1 and its closure.

blocks.name: diagonalEmbedding
blocks.text:
/-- The diagonal embedding $\varepsilon \mapsto (\varepsilon)_{P \mid p}$ of the global units
$\mathcal{O}_K^\times$ of $K$ into $\prod_{P \mid p} K_P^\times$. -/
noncomputable def diagonalEmbedding : (𝓞 K)ˣ →* AdicUnits K p :=
  Pi.monoidHom fun P => Units.map (algebraMap (𝓞 K) (P.1.adicCompletion K)).toMonoidHom

blocks.code:
def principalLocalUnits : Subgroup (AdicUnits K p) :=
  Subgroup.pi Set.univ fun P => (P.1.adicCompletionIntegers K).principalUnitGroup
blocks.docstring:
The group $U_1 = \prod_{P \mid p} U_{1,P}$ of principal local units, where
$U_{1,P} = \{u \in K_P^\times : v_P(u - 1) < 1\} = 1 + P\mathcal{O}_{K_P}$ is the group of
principal units of the completion $K_P$ (a subgroup of the local units
$U_P = \mathcal{O}_{K_P}^\times$).

justification.name: LeopoldtsConjecture.principalLocalUnits
justification.why_needed: U_1 = ∏_{P|p} U_{1,P}, the product of the principal unit groups of the completions.

blocks.name: principalLocalUnits
blocks.text:
/-- The group $U_1 = \prod_{P \mid p} U_{1,P}$ of principal local units, where
$U_{1,P} = \{u \in K_P^\times : v_P(u - 1) < 1\} = 1 + P\mathcal{O}_{K_P}$ is the group of
principal units of the completion $K_P$ (a subgroup of the local units
$U_P = \mathcal{O}_{K_P}^\times$). -/
def principalLocalUnits : Subgroup (AdicUnits K p) :=
  Subgroup.pi Set.univ fun P => (P.1.adicCompletionIntegers K).principalUnitGroup

blocks.code:
noncomputable def principalGlobalUnits : Subgroup (𝓞 K)ˣ :=
  (principalLocalUnits K p).comap (diagonalEmbedding K p)
blocks.docstring:
The group $E_1$ of global units of $K$ which map into $U_1$ under the diagonal embedding,
i.e. (see `LeopoldtsConjecture.mem_principalGlobalUnits_iff'`) the units $\varepsilon$ with
$\varepsilon \equiv 1 \pmod P$ for every prime $P$ of $K$ above $p$. It has finite index in
$\mathcal{O}_K^\times$, hence rank $r_1 + r_2 - 1$.

justification.closest_existing_considered: `Subgroup.comap` of `principalLocalUnits` along `diagonalEmbedding` (this is the definition); no existing notion of 'units congruent to 1 modulo all primes above p'.
justification.name: LeopoldtsConjecture.principalGlobalUnits
justification.why_needed: E_1, the global units mapping into U_1 under the diagonal embedding.

blocks.name: principalGlobalUnits
blocks.text:
/-- The group $E_1$ of global units of $K$ which map into $U_1$ under the diagonal embedding,
i.e. (see `LeopoldtsConjecture.mem_principalGlobalUnits_iff'`) the units $\varepsilon$ with
$\varepsilon \equiv 1 \pmod P$ for every prime $P$ of $K$ above $p$. It has finite index in
$\mathcal{O}_K^\times$, hence rank $r_1 + r_2 - 1$. -/
noncomputable def principalGlobalUnits : Subgroup (𝓞 K)ˣ :=
  (principalLocalUnits K p).comap (diagonalEmbedding K p)

blocks.code:
noncomputable def closurePrincipalGlobalUnits : Subgroup (AdicUnits K p) :=
  ((principalGlobalUnits K p).map (diagonalEmbedding K p)).topologicalClosure
blocks.docstring:
The closure $\overline{E_1}$ of the diagonal image of $E_1$ in $\prod_{P \mid p} K_P^\times$.
Since $U_1$ is closed in $\prod_{P \mid p} K_P^\times$ and contains the image of $E_1$, this is
the closure of $E_1$ embedded diagonally in $U_1$.

justification.name: LeopoldtsConjecture.closurePrincipalGlobalUnits
justification.why_needed: Ē_1, the topological closure of the diagonal image of E_1, whose ℤ_p-rank the conjecture concerns.

blocks.name: closurePrincipalGlobalUnits
blocks.text:
/-- The closure $\overline{E_1}$ of the diagonal image of $E_1$ in $\prod_{P \mid p} K_P^\times$.
Since $U_1$ is closed in $\prod_{P \mid p} K_P^\times$ and contains the image of $E_1$, this is
the closure of $E_1$ embedded diagonally in $U_1$. -/
noncomputable def closurePrincipalGlobalUnits : Subgroup (AdicUnits K p) :=
  ((principalGlobalUnits K p).map (diagonalEmbedding K p)).topologicalClosure

theorem leopoldts_conjecture [Fact p.Prime] :
    HasZpRank p (closurePrincipalGlobalUnits K p) (Units.rank K) := by
  sorry

blocks.code:
@[category API, AMS 11]
theorem mem_principalGlobalUnits_iff (ε : (𝓞 K)ˣ) :
    ε ∈ principalGlobalUnits K p ↔
      ∀ P : PrimesAbove K p, Valued.v (algebraMap (𝓞 K) (P.1.adicCompletion K) ε - 1) < 1 := by
  simp only [principalGlobalUnits, principalLocalUnits, Subgroup.mem_comap, Subgroup.mem_pi,
    Set.mem_univ, true_implies, ValuationSubring.mem_principalUnitGroup_iff]
  exact forall_congr' fun P =>
    (Valuation.isEquiv_valuation_valuationSubring _).lt_one_iff_lt_one.symm
blocks.name: mem_principalGlobalUnits_iff
blocks.text:
@[category API, AMS 11]

  simp only [principalGlobalUnits, principalLocalUnits, Subgroup.mem_comap, Subgroup.mem_pi,
    Set.mem_univ, true_implies, ValuationSubring.mem_principalUnitGroup_iff]

blocks.code:
@[category API, AMS 11]
theorem mem_principalGlobalUnits_iff' (ε : (𝓞 K)ˣ) :
    ε ∈ principalGlobalUnits K p ↔ ∀ P : PrimesAbove K p, (ε : 𝓞 K) - 1 ∈ P.1.asIdeal := by
  rw [mem_principalGlobalUnits_iff]
  refine forall_congr' fun P => ?_
  rw [← valuation_lt_one_iff_mem (K := K), ← valuedAdicCompletion_eq_valuation (K := K)]
  simp only [Algebra.cast, map_sub, map_one]
blocks.docstring:
A global unit lies in $E_1$ if and only if it is congruent to $1$ modulo every prime of $K$
above $p$.

claims.decomposer_note: Implicitly universally quantified over every number field K and every rational prime p; the precise form (from the article) is that the Z_p-rank of the p-adic closure of the global units E_1 (units mapping into the principal local units U_1 = prod_{P|p} U_{1,P}) embedded diagonally in U_1 equals r_1 + r_2 - 1, i.e. the Leopoldt defect is 0 — this rank formulation should be used rather than a literal determinant-style p-adic regulator, which (per Mihăilescu) only has a canonical definition for totally real/CM fields; the article's known special cases (abelian over Q or over imaginary quadratic fields, Ax–Brumer), the announced CM case, and Colmez's equivalence with a simple pole of the p-adic Dedekind zeta function at s = 1 are background results, not questions posed by the statement.
claims.reviewer_why: c07 states exactly the article's rank formulation: for every number field K and prime p (Fact p.Prime), E_1 = comap of U_1 = prod_{P|p} (adicCompletionIntegers).principalUnitGroup along the natural diagonal map (O_K)^x -> prod (K_P)^x, Ē_1 = topological closure of its image (closure taken in prod K_P^x, which equals the closure in U_1 since U_1 is clopen), and the conclusion 'rank_{Z_p} Ē_1 = r_1+r_2-1 = Units.rank K' is encoded as 'Ē_1 has an open subgroup topologically isomorphic to Z_p^{Units.rank K}'. I verified this encoding is equivalent in both directions for a closed subgroup of the f.g. Z_p-module U_1 (open subgroup => finite index and closed => Z_p-submodule of the same rank; a topological group iso from Z_p^r is automatically Z_p-linear; conversely Z_p^r x {0} is open in Z_p^r x T), including the r = 0 boundary case (Ē_1 finite, trivial subgroup open). Primitives checked in Mathlib: principalUnitGroup = {x : v(x-1) < 1}, Algebra (O_K) (adicCompletion K) is O_K -> K -> completion, Units topology coincides with the subspace topology since valued fields are topological division rings, Units.rank K = card(InfinitePlace K) - 1. c07 also has a meaningful test (Z_p^r has rank r) and proved API lemmas (ε ∈ E_1 ↔ ε - 1 ∈ P for all P | p). c03/c01 (dim_{Q_p} Hom_cont(Ē_1, Q_p)) are also correct alternatives; c08 is essentially the same as c07 but adds an unrequested Ax–Brumer variant. Rejected: c06 uses the algebraic Subgroup.closure while its docstring claims the topological closure; c02 uses an sSup-over-ℕ encoding and a norm on the adic completion; c04 is a correct but non-literal finite-level injectivity form; c05 uses a real-analytic limit encoding.

/-- A topological group $G$ *has $\mathbb{Z}_p$-rank $r$* if it has an open subgroup which is

For a finitely generated $\mathbb{Z}_p$-module $M$ carrying its $p$-adic topology (for instance

def HasZpRank (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (G : Type*) [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G] (r : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ H : Subgroup G, IsOpen (H : Set G) ∧ Nonempty (H ≃ₜ* (Fin r → Multiplicative ℤ_[p]))

@[category test, AMS 11]
theorem hasZpRank_pi (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (r : ℕ) :

        continuous_toFun := continuous_subtype_val
        continuous_invFun := continuous_id.subtype_mk _ }⟩⟩

variable (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] (p : ℕ)

/-- The primes $P$ of the number field $K$ lying above the rational prime $p$, i.e. the nonzero
prime ideals of the ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_K$ containing $p$. -/
abbrev PrimesAbove : Type _ := {P : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K) // (p : 𝓞 K) ∈ P.asIdeal}

/-- The product $\prod_{P \mid p} K_P^\times$ of the multiplicative groups of the completions
$K_P$ of $K$ at the primes $P$ above $p$, with the product topology. It contains the group
$\prod_{P \mid p} U_P$ of local units and the group $U_1 = \prod_{P \mid p} U_{1,P}$ of principal
local units, and it is the target of the diagonal embedding of the global units. -/
abbrev AdicUnits : Type _ := (P : PrimesAbove K p) → (P.1.adicCompletion K)ˣ

/-- The diagonal embedding $\varepsilon \mapsto (\varepsilon)_{P \mid p}$ of the global units
$\mathcal{O}_K^\times$ of $K$ into $\prod_{P \mid p} K_P^\times$. -/
noncomputable def diagonalEmbedding : (𝓞 K)ˣ →* AdicUnits K p :=
  Pi.monoidHom fun P => Units.map (algebraMap (𝓞 K) (P.1.adicCompletion K)).toMonoidHom

/-- The group $U_1 = \prod_{P \mid p} U_{1,P}$ of principal local units, where
$U_{1,P} = \{u \in K_P^\times : v_P(u - 1) < 1\} = 1 + P\mathcal{O}_{K_P}$ is the group of
principal units of the completion $K_P$ (a subgroup of the local units
$U_P = \mathcal{O}_{K_P}^\times$). -/
def principalLocalUnits : Subgroup (AdicUnits K p) :=
  Subgroup.pi Set.univ fun P => (P.1.adicCompletionIntegers K).principalUnitGroup

/-- The group $E_1$ of global units of $K$ which map into $U_1$ under the diagonal embedding,
i.e. (see `LeopoldtsConjecture.mem_principalGlobalUnits_iff'`) the units $\varepsilon$ with
$\varepsilon \equiv 1 \pmod P$ for every prime $P$ of $K$ above $p$. It has finite index in
$\mathcal{O}_K^\times$, hence rank $r_1 + r_2 - 1$. -/
noncomputable def principalGlobalUnits : Subgroup (𝓞 K)ˣ :=
  (principalLocalUnits K p).comap (diagonalEmbedding K p)

/-- The closure $\overline{E_1}$ of the diagonal image of $E_1$ in $\prod_{P \mid p} K_P^\times$.
Since $U_1$ is closed in $\prod_{P \mid p} K_P^\times$ and contains the image of $E_1$, this is
the closure of $E_1$ embedded diagonally in $U_1$. -/
noncomputable def closurePrincipalGlobalUnits : Subgroup (AdicUnits K p) :=
  ((principalGlobalUnits K p).map (diagonalEmbedding K p)).topologicalClosure

/-- **Leopoldt's conjecture.** Let $K$ be a number field and $p$ a rational prime. Then the
$p$-adic regulator of $K$ does not vanish. Precisely, in the formulation of the Wikipedia
article: the $\mathbb{Z}_p$-module rank of the closure $\overline{E_1}$ of $E_1$ (the global
units congruent to $1$ modulo every prime of $K$ above $p$) embedded diagonally in
$U_1 = \prod_{P \mid p} U_{1,P}$ equals $r_1 + r_2 - 1$ (which is `Units.rank K`), the rank of
the unit group of $K$; that is, the Leopoldt defect $\delta_p(K)$ is $0$. The
$\mathbb{Z}_p$-rank condition is expressed by `HasZpRank`: $\overline{E_1}$ has an open subgroup
topologically isomorphic to $\mathbb{Z}_p^{r_1 + r_2 - 1}$. -/
@[category research open, AMS 11]
theorem leopoldts_conjecture [Fact p.Prime] :
    HasZpRank p (closurePrincipalGlobalUnits K p) (Units.rank K) := by
  sorry

variable {K p}

@[category API, AMS 11]
theorem mem_principalGlobalUnits_iff (ε : (𝓞 K)ˣ) :
    ε ∈ principalGlobalUnits K p ↔
      ∀ P : PrimesAbove K p, Valued.v (algebraMap (𝓞 K) (P.1.adicCompletion K) ε - 1) < 1 := by
  simp only [principalGlobalUnits, principalLocalUnits, Subgroup.mem_comap, Subgroup.mem_pi,
    Set.mem_univ, true_implies, ValuationSubring.mem_principalUnitGroup_iff]
  exact forall_congr' fun P =>
    (Valuation.isEquiv_valuation_valuationSubring _).lt_one_iff_lt_one.symm

/-- A global unit lies in $E_1$ if and only if it is congruent to $1$ modulo every prime of $K$
above $p$. -/
@[category API, AMS 11]
theorem mem_principalGlobalUnits_iff' (ε : (𝓞 K)ˣ) :
    ε ∈ principalGlobalUnits K p ↔ ∀ P : PrimesAbove K p, (ε : 𝓞 K) - 1 ∈ P.1.asIdeal := by
  rw [mem_principalGlobalUnits_iff]
  refine forall_congr' fun P => ?_
  rw [← valuation_lt_one_iff_mem (K := K), ← valuedAdicCompletion_eq_valuation (K := K)]
  simp only [Algebra.cast, map_sub, map_one]

end LeopoldtsConjecture

items: The terse list entry ('a p-adic analogue of the regulator ... does not vanish') was made precise using the article's Formulation section: rank_{ℤ_p} of the closure of E_1 embedded diagonally in U_1 equals r_1 + r_2 - 1 (Leopoldt defect 0). r_1 + r_2 - 1 is taken as Mathlib's `NumberField.Units.rank K = card (InfinitePlace K) - 1`.

ℤ_p-rank: Mathlib has no ℤ_p-module structure on the principal units of a p-adic completion, so the condition 'rank_{ℤ_p} Ē_1 = r' is expressed by the bespoke predicate `HasZpRank p G r` := G has an open subgroup topologically isomorphic (`≃ₜ*`) to `Fin r → Multiplicative ℤ_[p]`. For a finitely generated ℤ_p-module M with its p-adic topology (e.g. any closed subgroup of U_1 ≅ ℤ_p^n × finite) this is equivalent to rank M = r: if M ≅ ℤ_p^r × T (T finite), ℤ_p^r × 0 is an open subgroup ≅ ℤ_p^r; conversely a continuous group isomorphism ℤ_p^r → H onto an open subgroup is automatically ℤ_p-linear (ℤ is dense in ℤ_p and the action is continuous) and H has finite index in compact M, so rank M = r. Reviewers should check this equivalence; it is the main modeling step.
Primes above p: `PrimesAbove K p := {P : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K) // (p : 𝓞 K) ∈ P.asIdeal}` (nonzero primes of 𝓞 K containing p, i.e. P | p).

Completions: K_P is `P.adicCompletion K`; the diagonal embedding is `Units.map (algebraMap (𝓞 K) (P.adicCompletion K))` on each factor (this algebraMap is definitionally 𝓞 K → K → completion). The ambient topological group is `∏_{P|p} (K_P)ˣ` with the product of the `Units` topologies (for a topological division ring this is the usual topology).

Principal local units U_{1,P} are `(P.adicCompletionIntegers K).principalUnitGroup`, i.e. {u ∈ K_Pˣ : v_P(u - 1) < 1} = 1 + P·O_{K_P}; U_1 is `Subgroup.pi Set.univ` of these. E_1 is `Subgroup.comap` of U_1 along the diagonal embedding, exactly as in the article; the API lemmas `mem_principalGlobalUnits_iff` / `mem_principalGlobalUnits_iff'` verify (with proofs) that this unfolds to v_P(ε - 1) < 1, resp. ε - 1 ∈ P for every P | p.
The closure Ē_1 is taken in ∏ (K_P)ˣ rather than literally inside U_1; since U_1 is closed (ultrametric balls are clopen) and contains the image of E_1, this is the same set with the same topology.

The known special cases (Ax–Brumer abelian case, announced CM case) and Colmez's zeta-function equivalence are mentioned only in the module docstring as background, not stated as theorems, following the decomposition notes.

A proved `@[category test]` (`hasZpRank_pi`: ℤ_p^r itself has ℤ_p-rank r) and two proved `@[category API]` lemmas were added as sanity checks for the bespoke definitions, per the repository's request for basic API tests.

reviewer_notes: The list-page statement is terse; all candidates and the final file use the precise formulation from the linked article (Z_p-rank of the closure of E_1 in U_1 equals r_1+r_2-1), as the decomposition notes prescribe. The one unavoidable modeling step is the encoding of 'Z_p-rank' since Mathlib has no Z_p-module structure on local principal units; the shipped file uses 'exists an open subgroup topologically isomorphic to Z_p^r' (c07's HasZpRank), which I checked is equivalent to the rank statement for closed subgroups of U_1. Closure is taken in prod_{P|p} K_P^x rather than literally inside U_1; U_1 is clopen there so this is the same set and topology (documented in the file). Final file is c07 verbatim (compiles with only the 'declaration uses sorry' warning). No candidate bailed out; c04's remark that the rank formulation cannot be written literally is correct but does not prevent a faithful equivalent encoding. c08's research-solved Ax–Brumer variant was not included because the decomposition table treats known special cases as background, not slots.
